requirements.details: Show The Shadows’ Vigil for the waterfall gorge of Frost Shadow and Flame Shadow and The Thousand Steps for the Glasswind colosseum in their player-facing map presentation. Carry the approved names into world lore and retain existing site IDs.

Use the existing approved river, pond, waterfall and lavafall artwork. Shape natural bends and connect streams, rivers, pools and basins to waterfalls or lavafalls where appropriate. Review Willow Cascades and the Emberreach lava channel specifically. Verify visible flow and alignment at normal and close zoom, with correct bridge crossings and terrain access.

Weather-responsive, individually varied tree sway already exists. Verify the existing behaviour across representative regions, vegetation and wind conditions, and fix remaining gaps while respecting animation settings and the map performance budget.

requirements.item: Grand bridge, offshore island and tower
requirements.details: Use a remote stretch of underused ocean to add a modest offshore island. Span a broad sea channel with a distinct grand bridge from the mainland to the island, with a walkable deck and natural approaches at both ends. Choose a site that preserves ferry navigation and enough open sea around the island. Build a grand tower on the island as a scenic landmark for the first release, with no tower entry, quest, reward or gameplay function. Preserve the separate existing Longwater Crossing. Validate the dock and ferry routes, public walking access and the scale of the bridge, island and tower on the local map and World Atlas.
